content:
**描述：**

本资源包为多种模组添加的盔甲纹饰与盔甲纹饰材质之间提供了兼容性。该资源包支持 Forge、Fabric 和 NeoForge，适用于游戏 1.21.2 及以下的所有版本！


**Curseforge：**
[https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/armor-trim-compats](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/armor-trim-compats)



**支持的模组：**

- Biomes O' Plenty
  
- Frostiful
  
- L_Ender's_Cataclysm
  
- Undergarden
  
- Twilight Forest
  
- Illager Invasion
  
- Geode Plus
  
- Galosphere Trims
  
- Deep Aether
  
- Aether Redux
  
- Upgrade Aquatic
  
- Neapolitan
  
- Atmospheric
  
- Alex's Caves
  
- Blue Skies
  
- Wilderness
  
- Jaden's Nether Expansion
